paragraphs: A booking marketplace in the spirit of Airbnb: guests search and book stays, hosts list and manage properties, and payments run through Stripe Checkout.
features: Listings: browse and search by destination, dates, and guest count (a toggle-based picker

with separate Adults, Children, Infants, and Pets counters; infants don't count toward a listing's capacity, and a pet count filters to listings with a "pet friendly" amenity). Detail pages include a photo gallery,…
Auth & roles: sign up as a guest or a host; hosts get a dashboard, guests get a trips page.
Host dashboard: create, edit, publish/unpublish, and delete listings; see upcoming
bookings per listing, plus a link into that listing's own availability calendar.

whatItDoes.text: A booking marketplace in the spirit of Airbnb: guests search and book stays, hosts list and manage properties, and payments run through Stripe Checkout.

requirements.text: To also test host payouts (Stripe Connect), enable Connect on the same Stripe account (Dashboard → Connect → get started; test mode needs no business verification) - no separate API key is needed, the existing STRIPESECRETKEY covers both.
